card.title: PANZER IV-J
card.text: Increase the operation cost by 1 after each time this unit attacks.
card.flavorText: The Panzer IV Ausführung J was the final production model of Germany’s most widely used medium tank of WWII. Introduced in early 1944, the J variant emphasized simplified construction to speed up manufacturing as Germany faced mounting battlefield losses and industrial strain. Key changes included the removal of the electric turret traverse motor, replaced by a manual crank, and the addition of a new 16-speed gearbox that allowed for smoother operation in difficult terrain. The J retained the long-barreled 75 mm KwK 40 L/48 gun, capable of engaging most Allied tanks effectively at medium range. Armor was slightly increased, and later models featured skirt armor plates for better protection against anti-tank rifles and shaped charges. To compensate for the weight and power limitations, a secondary fuel tank was added to extend operational range, reflecting the growing importance of mobile defense. Nearly 3,000 Panzer IV Js were built, forming the backbone of many panzer divisions until the end of the war. Despite being increasingly outmatched by newer Allied tanks, the Panzer IV J remained in frontline service across every theater where German forces fought. Its continued presence reflected the vehicle’s adaptability, robust design, and the limits of Germany’s late-war production capacity.
